headline: Update on public engagement on playground replacements, plus memos on streamlining city processes for outside event groups and on Burlington Forward.
summary: The agenda includes an update on public engagement on playground replacements. It also includes two memos for approval: one with recommendations on streamlining city processes for outside groups hosting events, and one on exploring relevant portions of Burlington Forward.
items: Update on public engagement on playground replacements - BPRW (15 minutes)
Approval of memo with recommendations on streamlining city processes for outside groups creating and hosting events in our city (20 minutes)
Approval of memo on PACC's exploration of relevant portions of Burlington Forward
location: Fletcher Free Library, 235 College St., and via Zoom
